en:bath.enDefinition: A tub or pool which is used for bathing: bathtub. · A building or area where bathing occurs. · Clipping of bathroom. · The act of bathing; an instance of this; the taking of a bath.

en:hired.enDefinition: A person who has been hired, especially in a cohort. · The state of being hired, or having a job; employment. · Payment for the temporary use of something.

en:site.enDefinition: The place where anything is fixed; situation; local position · A place fitted or chosen for any certain permanent use or occupation · The posture or position of a thing. · A computer installation, particularly one associated with an intranet or internet service or telecommunications.

en:knowledge.enDefinition: The fact of knowing about something; general understanding or familiarity with a subject, place, situation etc. · Awareness of a particular fact or situation; a state of having been informed or made aware of something. · Intellectual understanding; the state of appreciating truth or information. · Familiarity or understanding of a particular skill, branch of learning etc.
en:knowledge.deDefinition: Verständnis oder Fakten aus Erfahrung oder Bildung

en:led.enDefinition: A heavy, pliable, inelastic metal element, having a bright, bluish color, but easily tarnished; both malleable and ductile, though with little tenacity. It is easily fusible, forms alloys with other metals, and is an ingredient of solder and type metal. Atomic number 82. · A plummet or mass of lead attached to a line, used in sounding depth at sea or to estimate velocity in knots. · A thin strip of type metal, used to separate lines of type in printing. · Vertical space in advance of a row or between rows of text. Also known as leading.

en:guests.enDefinition: A recipient of hospitality, especially someone staying by invitation at the house of another. · A patron or customer in a hotel etc. · An invited visitor or performer to an institution or to a broadcast. · A user given temporary access to a system despite not having an account of their own.

en:celebrate.enDefinition: To extol or honour in a solemn manner. · To honour by rites, by ceremonies of joy and respect, or by refraining from ordinary business; to observe duly. · To engage in joyful activity in appreciation of an event. · To perform or participate in, as a sacrament or solemn rite; to perform with appropriate rites.

en:map.enDefinition: To represent by means of a map. · To create a map of; to examine or survey in order to gather information for a map. · To have a direct relationship; to correspond. · To create a direct relationship to; to create a correspondence with.

en:horn.enDefinition: growth on the heads of certain animals
en:horn.pairedSense: growth on the heads of certain animals

en:eventually.enDefinition: In the end; at some later time, especially after a long time, a series of problems, struggles, delays or setbacks. · For some tail; for all terms beyond some term; with only finitely many exceptions. · Possibly, potentially, perhaps.

en:pity.enDefinition: A feeling of sympathy at the misfortune or suffering of someone or something. · Feeling of contempt one has for someone who is hopelessly inferior. · Something regrettable.

en:powers.enDefinition: physics: measure of the rate of doing work or transferring energy
en:powers.pairedSense: physics: measure of the rate of doing work or transferring energy

en:assume.enDefinition: To authenticate by means of belief; to surmise; to suppose to be true, especially without proof. · To take on a position, duty or form. · To adopt a feigned quality or manner; to claim without right; to arrogate. · To receive, adopt (a person).
en:assume.deDefinition: annehmen, voraussetzen, unterstellen · übernehmen (eine Schuld, ein Amt, eine Pflicht), auf sich nehmen (eine Gefahr) · annehmen, bekommen, sich zulegen, sich geben, sich angewöhnen (Gestalt, Eigenschaft) · sich anmaßen, sich aneignen

en:glasses.enDefinition: An amorphous solid, often transparent substance, usually made by melting silica sand with various additives (for most purposes, a mixture of soda, potash and lime is added). · Any amorphous solid (one without a regular crystal lattice). · A vessel from which one drinks, especially one made of glass, plastic, or similar translucent or semi-translucent material. · The quantity of liquid contained in such a vessel.
en:glasses.deDefinition: eine Sehhilfe bestehend aus einem Gestell und zwei Gläsern; Brille

en:rise.enDefinition: To move upwards. · To grow upward; to attain a certain height. · To slope upward. · To appear to move upwards from behind the horizon of a planet as a result of the planet's rotation.

en:fixed.enDefinition: not changing, not able to be changed, staying the same
en:fixed.pairedSense: not changing, not able to be changed, staying the same

en:request.enDefinition: To ask for (something). · To ask (somebody) to do something.

en:officers.enDefinition: One who has a position of authority in a hierarchical organization, especially in military, police or government organizations. · A respectful term of address for an officer, especially a police officer. · One who holds a public office. · An agent or servant imparted with the ability, to some degree, to act on initiative.

en:data.definition: bilgi, malumat · data, veri · datum. çoğul · Genellikle yapılandırılmış formatta takdim edilen kayıtlı gözlemler.

en:per.enDefinition: For each. · To each, in each (used in expressing ratios of units). · By the, through the (with name of body part in Latin). · In accordance with, as per.
en:per.deDefinition: für jedes/jeden einer Menge; pro · in Übereinstimmung mit etwas; entsprechend, gemäß

en:depends.enDefinition: To be contingent or conditioned; to have something as a necessary condition · To trust; to have confidence; to rely. · To hang down; to be sustained by being fastened or attached to something above, especially in heraldry, where a badge, decoration, or element is suspended from another part of an achievement of arms. · To cause to be contingent or dependent on; to set as a necessity.
en:depends.deDefinition: hängen, abhängen, abhängig sein · sich auf jemanden verlassen

en:jury.enDefinition: A group of individuals chosen from the general population to hear and decide a case in a court of law. · A group of judges in a competition. · The audience attending the first night of a performance, whose reaction may determine whether it succeeds or fails.

en:waited.definition: wait sözcüğünün basit geçmiş zaman ve geçmiş zaman ortaç çekimi
en:waited.enDefinition: To delay movement or action until some event or time; to remain neglected or in readiness. · To wait tables; to serve customers in a restaurant or other eating establishment. · To remain faithful to one’s partner or betrothed during a prolonged period of absence.

en:positive.enDefinition: Included, present, characterized by affirmation. · Formally laid down. · Stated definitively and without qualification. · Fully assured in opinion.

en:attorney.enDefinition: A lawyer; one who advises or represents others in legal matters as a profession. · An agent or representative authorized to act on someone else's behalf in accordance with that person's instructions. · An honorific given to lawyers and notaries public, or those holders by profession who also do other jobs. Usually capitalized or abbreviated as Atty. · An attorney tree (Clusia spp.)

en:direction.definition: doğrultu, istikamet, taraf, veçhe, yan, yön
en:direction.enDefinition: A theoretical line (physically or mentally) followed from a point of origin or towards a destination. May be relative (e.g. up, left, outbound, dorsal), geographical (e.g. north), rotational (e.g. clockwise), or with respect to an object or location (e.g. toward Boston). · A general trend for future action. · Guidance, instruction. · The work of the director in cinema or theater; the skill of directing a film, play etc.
en:direction.deDefinition: Anleitung, Anordnung, Anweisung, Vorschrift · Ausrichtung · Führung · Hinweis

en:families.enDefinition: immediate family [as a group], e.g. parents and their children
en:families.pairedSense: immediate family [as a group], e.g. parents and their children

en:useless.enDefinition: Without use or the possibility to be used. · Unhelpful, not useful; pointless (of an action). · Good-for-nothing; not dependable. · Of a person, Unable to do well at a particular task or endeavor.

en:grant.enDefinition: To give (permission or wish). · To give (bestow upon or confer, particularly in answer to prayer or request). · To agree with (someone) on (something); to accept (something) for the sake of argument; to admit to (someone) that (something) is true. · To assent; to consent.

en:saving.enDefinition: A reduction in cost or expenditure. · Something (usually money) that is saved, particularly money that has been set aside for the future. · The action of the verb to save.

en:speaks.enDefinition: To communicate with one's voice, to say words out loud. · To have a conversation. · To communicate or converse by some means other than orally, such as writing or facial expressions. · To deliver a message to a group; to deliver a speech.
en:speaks.deDefinition: mit der Stimme kommunizieren, Wörter laut sagen · eine Unterhaltung führen

en:fought.enDefinition: To engage in combat with; to oppose physically, to contest with. · To conduct or engage in (battle, warfare, a cause, etc.). · To contend in physical conflict, either singly or in war, battle, etc. · To contend in physical conflict with each other, either singly or in war, battle, etc.
en:fought.deDefinition: jemanden bekämpfen, bekriegen, kämpfen mit/ gegen, sich schlagen mit, boxen gegen, ankämpfen gegen · einen Krieg/ einen Prozess führen, eine Schlacht schlagen, eine Sache ausfechten · verfechten, sich einsetzen für · erkämpfen

en:meal.enDefinition: Food that is prepared and eaten, usually at a specific time, and usually in a comparatively large quantity. · Food served or eaten as a repast. · A break taken by a police officer in order to eat.

en:deliver.enDefinition: To set free from restraint or danger. · To assist in the birth of. · To assist (a female) in bearing, that is, in bringing forth (a child). · To give birth to.
en:deliver.deDefinition: befreien, erlösen · ein Kind entbinden · entsenden · zustellen, übergeben, abliefern

en:temple.enDefinition: place of worship — see also place of worship
en:temple.pairedSense: place of worship — see also place of worship

en:scary.enDefinition: Causing fear or anxiety · Uncannily striking or surprising. · Subject to sudden alarm; easily frightened.

en:millions.enDefinition: The cardinal number 1 000 000: 10⁶; a thousand thousand (1,000²). · An unspecified very large number.

en:regular.enDefinition: Bound by religious rule; belonging to a monastic or religious order (often as opposed to secular). · Having a constant pattern; showing evenness of form or appearance. · Both equilateral and equiangular; having all sides of the same length, and all (corresponding) angles of the same size · Whose faces are all congruent regular polygons, equally inclined to each other.

en:carrying.enDefinition: To lift (something) and take it to another place; to transport (something) by lifting. · To notionally transfer from one place (such as a country, book, or column) to another. · To convey by extension or continuance; to extend. · To lead or guide.

en:jacket.enDefinition: A piece of clothing worn on the upper body outside a shirt or blouse, often waist length to thigh length. · A piece of a person's suit, beside trousers and, sometimes, waistcoat; coat (US). · An outer garment (usually white) intended for chefs and which may be taken to signify status. · A vest (US); a waistcoat (UK).
en:jacket.deDefinition: Jacke, Jackett, Sakko, Wams · Buchumschlag, Schutzumschlag, Umschlag · Ummantelung, Umhüllung · Zylindermantel

en:switch.enDefinition: A device to turn electric current on and off or direct its flow. · A change or exchange. · A movable section of railroad track which allows the train to be directed down one of two destination tracks; (set of) points. · A long, slender woody plant stem or a flexible, thin rod used as a whip to administer corporal punishment in the United States.
en:switch.deDefinition: dünner und biegsamer Zweig von einem Baum oder Strauch · Bündel fremden oder künstlichen Haars zur Ergänzung des eigenen Kopfhaars · vollkommenes und besonders plötzliches Umstellen oder Umschwenken vom einen zum anderen · elektrische Verbindung herstellendes oder trennendes Gerät

en:grave.definition: mezar, kabir, sin, makber, gömüt, görün

en:role.enDefinition: A character or part played by a performer or actor. · The expected behaviour of an individual in a society. · The function or position of something. · Designation that denotes an associated set of responsibilities, knowledge, skills, or privileges

en:sexy.enDefinition: Having sex appeal; attractive. · Intriguing, appealing, likely to excite interest.
en:sexy.deDefinition: sexuell attraktiv und/oder verführerisch, sexy · ansprechend, anziehend, blickfangend, schön, verlockend

en:faces.enDefinition: The front part of the head of a human or other animal, featuring the eyes, nose, and mouth, and the surrounding area. · One's facial expression. · A distorted facial expression; an expression of displeasure, insult, etc. · The amount expressed on a bill, note, bond, etc., without any interest or discount; face value.

en:becomes.enDefinition: begin to be; turn into (often with permanent states). · To come about; happen; come into being; arise. · To be appropriate for. · Of an adornment, piece of clothing etc.: to look attractive on (someone).

en:badly.enDefinition: In a bad manner. · Very much; to a great degree.

en:confused.enDefinition: To puzzle, perplex, baffle, bewilder (somebody); to afflict by being complicated, contradictory, or otherwise difficult to understand. · To mix up, muddle up (one thing with another); to mistake (one thing for another). · To mix thoroughly; to confound; to disorder. · To be confused.

en:affair.enDefinition: Something which is done or is to be done; business of any kind, commercial, professional, or public. · Any proceeding or action which it is wished to refer to or characterize vaguely. · An action or engagement not of sufficient magnitude to be called a battle. · A material object (vaguely designated).

en:television.enDefinition: An electronic communication medium that allows the transmission of real-time visual images, and often sound. · An electronic home entertainment device equipped with a screen and a speaker for receiving television signals and displaying them in audio-visual form. · Collectively, the programs broadcast via the medium of television.

en:shock.enDefinition: A sudden, heavy impact. · Something so surprising that it is stunning. · A sudden or violent emotional disturbance. · An experience that leaves someone shaken; a very surprising, exhilarating or amazing experience.

en:panting.enDefinition: present participle and gerund of pant
en:panting.deDefinition: Partizip Präsens (present participle) des Verbs pant

en:clears.enDefinition: To remove obstructions, impediments or other unwanted items from. · To remove (items or material) so as to leave something unobstructed or open. · To leave abruptly; to clear off or clear out. · To become free from obstruction or obscurement; to become transparent.

en:patients.enDefinition: Willing to wait if necessary; not losing one's temper while waiting. · Constant in pursuit or exertion; persevering; calmly diligent.

en:watched.enDefinition: to look at for a period of time
en:watched.pairedSense: to look at for a period of time

en:committed.definition: to commit fiilinin geçmiş zaman ve isim-fiil çekimi
en:committed.enDefinition: To give in trust; to put into charge or keeping; to entrust; to consign; used with to or formerly unto. · To imprison: to forcibly place in a jail. · To forcibly evaluate and treat in a medical facility, particularly for presumed mental illness. · To do (something bad); to perpetrate, as a crime, sin, or fault.

en:sexual.enDefinition: Arising from the fact of being male or female; pertaining to sex or gender, or to the social relations between the sexes. · Capable of sexual reproduction; sexed, sexuate. · Pertaining to sexual intercourse or other intimate physical contact. · Characterised by sexual feelings or behaviour; possessing sexuality.

en:suffer.definition: ıstırap çekmek; acı çekmek · başına gelmek.

en:wherever.enDefinition: Where ever; an emphatic form of where. · In, at or to any place that one likes or chooses. · The place (no matter where) in, at or to which.

en:plate.enDefinition: A slightly curved but almost flat dish from which food is served or eaten. · Such dishes collectively. · The contents of such a dish. · A course at a meal.

en:appear.definition: ortaya çıkmak, görünür olmak, belirmek, tezahür etmek · gözükmek, görünmek
en:appear.enDefinition: To come or be in sight; to be in view; to become visible. · To come before the public. · To stand in presence of some authority, tribunal, or superior person, to answer a charge, plead a cause, etc.; to present oneself as a party or advocate before a court, or as a person to be tried. · To become visible to the apprehension of the mind; to be known as a subject of observation or comprehension, or as a thing proved; to be obvious or manifest.

en:clever.enDefinition: Nimble with hands or body; dexterous; skillful; adept. · Quick to understand, learn, and devise or apply ideas; intelligent. · Mentally quick and resourceful; skilled at achieving what one wants in a mentally agile and inventive way. · Smart, intelligent, or witty; mentally quick or sharp.

en:shots.pairedSense: small metal balls used as ammunition

en:bang.enDefinition: A sudden percussive noise. · A heavy strike upon an object causing such a noise. · An explosion. · The symbol !, known as an exclamation point.

en:poison.enDefinition: A substance that is harmful or lethal to a living organism when ingested. · Anything harmful to a person or thing. · An alcoholic drink. (Mainly in the phrases "name your poison" and "what's your poison?") · Any substance that inhibits catalytic activity.

en:drove.enDefinition: The herd being driven in a cattle (or other animal) drive; thus, a number of animals driven to market or new pastures; a group of livestock animals more generally. · A large number of people on the move. · A group of other animals, especially hares when seen in coursing or hunting. · A road or track along which cattle are habitually, used to be or could be driven; a droveway.

en:yourselves.definition: (2. çoğul şahıs için) kendi, kendiniz, kendinize, kendinizde, kendinizden · kendiniz (bizzat siz)

en:babies.enDefinition: very young human being — see also child
en:babies.pairedSense: very young human being — see also child

en:yellow.enDefinition: The color of sunflower petals and lemons; the color obtained by mixing green and red light, or by subtracting blue from white light; the color evoked by light of wavelength around 580 nm; one of the three primary colors in subtractive color systems. · The middle light in a set of three traffic lights, the lighting of which indicates that drivers should stop short of the intersection if it is safe to do so. · One of the color balls used in snooker, with a value of 2 points. · One of two groups of object balls, or a ball from that group, as used in the principally British version of pool that makes use of unnumbered balls (the yellow(s) and red(s)); contrast stripes and solids in the originally American version with numbered balls).

en:picking.enDefinition: A tool used for digging; a pickaxe. · An anchor. · A pointed hammer used for dressing millstones. · A tool for unlocking a lock without the original key; a lock pick, picklock.
